content.title: OGN Q3 2025 Deep Dive: Leadership Changes, Portfolio Shifts, and Guidance Recalibration
content.summary: Pharmaceutical company Organon (NYSE:OGN) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 1.3% year on year to $1.60 billion.
